summary: Enhance your skills with our Risk Assessment for OHS Professionals Training Course. Learn to identify, evaluate, and manage workplace risks effectively.
lede: OHS risk assessment helps workplace safety professionals identify hazards and decide which controls to document and review. The course covers task-based hazard analysis, likelihood and severity scoring, and selecting controls using the hierarchy of controls. Participants practice recording findings in risk registers and action plans, verifying controls through inspections, and communicating residual risk to supervisors and leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess workplace hazards, assign risk ratings, and document controls in operational settings.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of workplace safety operations, incident reporting, or site inspections. Familiarity with basic hazard identification is helpful, but prior experience with ISO 45001, job safety analysis, or formal risk matrices is not required. No coding or programming is required; learners should bring a laptop for digital templates, risk register exercises, and worksheet-based calculations.
